in_marathi.name: Chiravansh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Eternal lineage, dynasty
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chiravansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Chiravansh is derived from the Sanskrit words 'chira' meaning eternal and 'vansh' meaning lineage or dynasty. This name is associated with the idea of an eternal and unbroken lineage, often referring to royalty or a noble family heritage.
